title: quadlet: add support for installing .quadlets files from a URL
body:
Previously, when a .quadlets file was passed to podman quadlet install
as a URL, it was not split into its sections and the whole file was copied as is. 

I moved that logic into a new installMultiQuadletFile function and call
it from both the local path and the URL path. I also added a system test
that installs a .quadlets file from a URL.

This PR description was translated from Korean to English using an LLM.

Fixes: #30145
